title: THR flak claim — can Doubt preserve repetition vs corroboration?
question: Does the checked Human Record evidence establish that roughly 80% of German anti-aircraft crew members died during the Second World War?
verdict: No. In the sources checked by The Human Record, the claim is not established; downstream repetition is not independent corroboration and the true aggregate mortality rate remains unknown.

nodes.label: Current position
nodes.text: The checked record does not establish the 80% mortality claim.

nodes.label: Dependent repetition
nodes.text: The linked article and automated summary are downstream restatements of the video claim rather than independent corroboration.

nodes.label: Checked-source ceiling
nodes.text: The Human Record says the authoritative sources checked support nearby facts but do not establish the aggregate German flak-crew mortality claim.

nodes.label: True aggregate mortality
nodes.text: The true aggregate mortality rate of German anti-aircraft crews remains unknown in this record.

edges.note: The cited THR source region explicitly says these downstream nodes are not independent corroboration.
